source: ogwells.htm (inside kyog_dd.zip, KGS documentation V14); Plug_Afdvt label derived from its field description

Org_WClass.DPTD: Deeper pool test resulting in development of existing producing formation
Org_WClass.SRV: Service well, EPA Class II injection
Org_WClass.STR: Stratigraphic test with records released to the public
Org_WClass.WSW: Water supply well (note, should be SRV with an Org_Result of WS)

Org_Result.AB: Well known to be abandoned but with no plugging information on file
Org_Result.LOC: Location (new permit issued or insufficient data)

IOF_IP.DISP: the deepest pay reported is a disposal zone
IOF_IP.INJECT: the deepest pay reported is an injection zone
IOF_IP.MCFGPD: thousand cubic feet of natural gas per day
IOF_IP.MMCF: million cubic feet of natural gas per day
IOF_IP.SUPPLY: the deepest pay reported is a water-supply zone

bore_type.V: Conventional vertical well bore (not intentionally deviated)
bore_type.D: A deviated well bore (intentionally deviated, but does not reach horizontal)
bore_type.H: A horizontal well bore potentially including multiple laterals and pinnate deviations from those laterals

PlotSymbol.D&A: Dry and abandoned wells (Abnd = -1 by default)
PlotSymbol.GAS: Wells completed as gas wells (including abandoned producers)
PlotSymbol.LOC: Newly permitted locations or historic wells for which completion data are not available in the KGS database
PlotSymbol.MSC: Miscellaneous well types, including cathodic protection, observation, water supply wells, and others
PlotSymbol.O&G: Wells completed as combined oil and gas producers (including abandoned producers)
PlotSymbol.OIL: Wells completed as oil (including abandoned producers)
PlotSymbol.SRV: Secondary recovery input, water injection, and other miscellaneous well types associated with secondary or enhanced oil recovery (EPA Class II wells)
PlotSymbol.STR: Stratigraphic tests released to the public (Abnd = -1 by default)
PlotSymbol.TRM: Locations for which a permit was issued but the permit was cancelled by the operator or allowed to expire. Wells with this designation are included to enable tracking the status of permits.
